page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the top of a psalm (verses 2 to 9) above a new heading, "PSALMVS CL. VI. VERS.", a subtitle line, and verses 1 and 2 below. A printer's mark sits at the lower right. No notes in the margins. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: 2. Lætare Iuda, factor enim tuus Idem tuus Rex, læta Sion tum[?]æ.
3. Regem decorum tibia personet, Sint iuncta plectris tympana dulcibus.
4. Rex plebe gaudet, ceu tua Rege plebs Pacata, quam Rex cingit honoribus.
5. Regnum beatum, nobile, splendidum, Cives inhebunt[?] mollibus è thoris.
6. Procinctus equis latus? quantum Enses, bipennes è manibus micant:
7. Nempe ut prophanos puniat asperè, Castiget hostes compede ferrea,
8. Reges triumphatos trahat & premat, Pompam sequetur, prona ducum cohors.
9. Iusti è quadrigis in titulo gerent, Hic apparatus debitus est bonis.
main_text.head: PSALMVS CL. VI. VERS.
Heb. totidem Latinis.
main_text.p: 1. LAVDATE primatem ætherei poli, Laudate regem stelliferi throni Crystallinæ sphæræ insidentem, Qui rutilos rotat vnus axes.
2. Laudate fortis robora dexteræ, Laudetur eius fulgida gloria Aulæa qui cæli tetendit Quem aligeri celebrant ministri.

page.notes: Verse 2 "tuæ" is printed with an unclear letter, read as "tum[?]æ". Verse 3 "iuncta" is hard to read. Verse 5 "inhebunt" may be a printing error for a different verb. The printer's mark at the lower right is copied as a foot line. The psalm heading CL is the psalm number 150, given as caput.
